item.title: US military conducts more deadly strikes against vessels of alleged 'narco-terrorists'
item.summary: SOUTHCOM says two deadly strikes targeted vessels on known narcotrafficking routes in the Eastern Pacific, killing five alleged narcoterrorists.

item.title: More patients demand ‘unvaccinated’ blood, doctors warn of growing health risks
item.summary: More patients are requesting unvaccinated blood for transfusions since COVID-19 vaccines were approved, but experts say it poses risks, not benefits.

item.title: Hasan Piker calls Republican Party the 'biggest domestic terrorist' in the country
item.summary: Far-left streamer Hasan Piker said the Republican Party is the world's biggest terrorist organization in both the U.S. and abroad on "Pod Save America."

item.summary: Get all the stories you need-to-know from the most powerful name in news delivered first thing every morning to your inbox.

item.title: Melania Trump’s Epstein remarks turn up the heat on DOJ, Acting AG Todd Blanche to do more
item.summary: Melania Trump's appeal for Congress to hear from Jeffrey Epstein survivors is adding pressure on the DOJ and its new acting director as lawmakers and alleged victims demand more action.

item.title: ESPN star calls for 2017 Masters winner to have his lifetime exemption removed after meltdown
item.summary: Mike Greenberg called for Sergio Garcia to lose his lifetime Masters exemption after Garcia smashed his driver and received a code of conduct warning.

item.title: Two arrested in possible shooting near OpenAI CEO Sam Altman's home
item.summary: Two people have been arrested after a gunshot was allegedly fired near OpenAI CEO Sam Altman's San Francisco home, according to a report.

item.title: Trump congratulates Rory McIlroy on back-to-back Masters wins: 'Becoming more and more a legend'
item.summary: President Donald Trump congratulated Rory McIlroy on winning the 90th Masters Tournament, calling him a legend who performed tremendously under intense pressure.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo calls sidelining 'disrespectful' as Bucks' season comes to end
item.summary: Giannis Antetokounmpo expressed frustration with the Milwaukee Bucks for keeping him sidelined, saying players don't have control over their own playing time.

item.title: Discovery at Monticello reveals construction secrets Thomas Jefferson left out of maps and letters
item.summary: Archaeologists uncovered a previously unknown brick kiln at Thomas Jefferson's Monticello, dating to a time before he wrote the Declaration of Independence.
